atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for GBPUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=2.657, trend_persistence=0.271, mean_reversion=0.729. Learned timeframe weights: M15 (w=+0.313), H4 (w=+0.266), H1 (w=+0.189). Ablation-retained features: ema_trend (w=+0.174), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.168), liquidity_sweep (w=+0.145), fvg_impulse (w=+0.130) (pruned/left out by ablation: none).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for GBPUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=2.657, mean-reversion=0.729). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to M15 (w=+0.313), H4 (w=+0.266), H1 (w=+0.189). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [ema_trend (w=+0.174), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.168), liquidity_sweep (w=+0.145), fvg_impulse (w=+0.130)] and pruned [none].

penalty_hierarchy.unnecessary_early_stop_counterfactual_pe: If trade stops out early (breakeven or early close) and post-exit price action reaches Major TP without hitting initial SL, charge forgone_tp_r penalty.
